args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. At the time of response, v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with an error rate of 0.18 and healthy=false. Release history shows v2.3.1 as unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout status: rolled_out, execution state VERIFIED. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health recovery on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy, and it was running in all three regions with an error rate of 0.18 before the rollback.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failing v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

I haven't checked live health or error rate since the rollback, so that still needs confirming. The incident lists follow-ups: confirm recovery on v2.3.0 and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.
